summary: Service providers are sometimes legally required to map a subscriber's inside address to the public address they used, but logging every dynamic translation in a Carrier-Grade NAT is heavy. This document describes assigning ports in a predictable, deterministic way so the mapping can be worked out without logging each translation.

eli5.summary: Many homes share a few public addresses. Instead of writing down every time someone borrows one, the provider hands out turns by a fixed rule, so later it can just work out who had which one.
